asked.item: What the 3-retries Unknown error reason means
Third failure this week, what to do next

verdict.reason: The TikTok FAQ explains this error, says to check for an existing post before retrying, and says to send evidence to support.

steps.text: This error means Blotato exhausted its publishing retry loop.
Unknown error reason means the stored TikTok failure reason has no matching description, and it does not prove a TikTok outage, a Blotato fault, or a credit problem.
Check the TikTok account for an existing post before retrying.
Record the complete error, submission ID when available, destination, and time, then send that evidence to support so the team checks the raw TikTok failure reason and publishing logs.
Do not reconnect solely because the reason is unknown.
